Dry run for acme/sample (default branch main)

  - label risk:low
      gh label create risk:low --color 0e8a16 --description Autonomy gate: merges itself when the checks pass --force
  - label risk:medium
      gh label create risk:medium --color fbca04 --description Autonomy gate: not proven by a machine, a person merges --force
  - label risk:high
      gh label create risk:high --color b60205 --description Autonomy gate: changes the rules, a code owner decides --force
  - label intent
      gh label create intent --color 5319e7 --description A human intent for the agents --force
  - label agent:spec
      gh label create agent:spec --color 1d76db --description Agent writes the spec only --force
  - label agent:implement
      gh label create agent:implement --color 1d76db --description Agent writes spec + implementation + PR --force
  - label spec:needs-approval
      gh label create spec:needs-approval --color d93f0b --description Spec waits for a human decision --force
  - label spec:approved
      gh label create spec:approved --color 0e8a16 --description Human approved the spec; agent implements --force
  - label agent-review:approved
      gh label create agent-review:approved --color 0e8a16 --description Independent agent review found no blockers --force
  - label agent-review:changes
      gh label create agent-review:changes --color d93f0b --description Independent agent review requested changes --force
  - squash-only merges, delete merged branches, auto-merge
      gh api -X PATCH repos/acme/sample -F allow_auto_merge=true -F delete_branch_on_merge=true -F allow_squash_merge=true -F allow_merge_commit=false -F allow_rebase_merge=false
  - GitHub Actions cannot approve PRs (no merge needs an approval from it)
      gh api -X PUT repos/acme/sample/actions/permissions/workflow -f default_workflow_permissions=read -F can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false
  - environment staging
      gh api -X PUT repos/acme/sample/environments/staging
  - environment production (human approval by @acme)
      gh api -X PUT repos/acme/sample/environments/production --input -
  - ruleset on main: PR + no code owner review (one decider: @acme) + checks check, gate, secret-scan, conventional-title, conventional-commits
      gh api -X POST repos/acme/sample/rulesets --input -

  ! governance/autonomy.yaml names one decider for the rules (@acme), and GitHub does not let the author of a pull request approve it: the machine opens pull requests as that account. So the ruleset asks for no code owner review on any path CODEOWNERS names, the rules and the medium paths alike, and @acme merging a pull request is the decision. That the machine never merges a medium or high pull request itself is then kept by word (AGENTS.md), also for the agents on GitHub, which have write access. Name a second decider under owners.high to ask for a code owner review again.

Secrets (values are never read):
  ! missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.
    Easiest: in Claude Code run /install-github-app, or `claude setup-token`
    then `gh secret set CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. Also install https://github.com/apps/claude
  ! RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN is missing: releases are off until it is set.
    GitHub Actions may not open pull requests with its own token: store a
    PAT or GitHub App token that may, with `gh secret set RELEASE_PLEASE_TOKEN`.

Run again with --apply to make these changes.
